summary: A narrator recounts a weekend live-action game in the woods where players 'kill' each other with tags and killed players become monsters. Charles repeatedly ignores the no-contact rule and tackles the narrator from behind, cutting his lip and causing a bloody nose. The narrator and Darryl retaliate, Darryl trips Charles, and a referee removes Charles from the game after seeing his conduct that weekend, then lectures the narrator and Darryl that their retaliation was no more justified. The excerpt ends with the pair getting back at Charles that night in the scout dorms.
one_line: A narrator is injured when Charles repeatedly breaks the no-contact rule in a woods game, leading to his removal by a referee.
key_facts: The game is played in the woods, and players who are 'killed' can switch to playing monsters.
Charles repeatedly broke the no-contact rule over the weekend, and the refs called him on it several times.
Charles was one of the bigger kids at the game and was fond of 'accidentally' tackling people at the end of a chase.
Charles tackled the narrator from behind while the narrator was treasure-hunting near Darryl, throwing him to the ground so hard he could not breathe for a moment.
Charles yelled 'Gotcha!' after tackling the narrator.
The narrator's nose was bleeding and his lip was split after he face-planted onto a root during the tackle.
Darryl's foot hooked Charles's ankle and sent him sprawling as Charles tried to flee.
A ref whistled and sent Charles back to the camp entrance, declaring him out of the game.
The ref lectured the narrator and Darryl that their retaliation was no more justified than Charles's attack.
That night, after the games ended, everyone took hot showers in the scout dorms.
Darryl and the narrator stole Charles's clothes and towel and tied them in knots.

entities.name: Charles
entities.role: Bigger kid at the game who repeatedly broke the no-contact rule and tackled the narrator, and was removed by a ref

entities.name: Darryl
entities.role: Friend of the narrator who was treasure-hunting, helped flank Charles, tripped him, and stole his clothes

entities.name: the narrator
entities.role: First-person protagonist who was tackled, injured, and retaliated against Charles

entities.name: the ref
entities.role: Referee who removed Charles from the game and lectured the narrator and Darryl

entities.name: scout dorms
entities.role: Dorms where the players took hot showers after the games ended
